input: The VPN client says my certificate expired. What do I do?
expected: Renew the certificate from the self-service portal, then reconnect

input: How do I get access to the finance dashboard?
expected: Raise an access request in the service catalogue and pick the finance-readers group

input: My laptop will not join the guest wifi in the Dublin office.
Can I install the beta build of the design tool?
expected: Beta builds need a security review first; open a software request and note that it is a beta

input: I am locked out after too many password attempts. How long until it clears?
expected: The lockout clears after 15 minutes, or immediately if you reset the password from an enrolled device

input: Where do I find the retention policy for shared drives?
expected: Shared drives keep files for 400 days after last access; the policy page is under Workplace, Records

input: My new starter has no email address on their first day. Who fixes that?
Can I use a personal password manager for work logins?
expected: Work credentials go in the managed password manager only; personal vaults are out of scope for recovery and audit

input: The meeting room display will not accept my screen share.
expected: Screen share needs the room to be on the same VLAN; join the meeting from the room calendar entry rather than sharing directly

input: How do I report a phishing email?
expected: do not delete it first, the button needs the message

input: Why is my laptop asking me to enrol again?
expected: Re-enrol from Company Portal after an OS upgrade; the previous enrolment record is dropped.

input: Where do I request a second monitor?
expected: Raise a hardware request in the service catalogue and choose the peripherals form.

input: Does the office printer support duplex by default?
expected: No; duplex is off by default and is set per print job.

input: How do I get a temporary badge?
expected: Reception issues one against your employee id and it expires at midnight.

input: What is the limit on mailbox size?
expected: Fifty gigabytes; over that, new mail is rejected rather than queued.

input: Can contractors join the internal wiki?
expected: Yes with a sponsor; the sponsor approves the request in the access catalogue.

input: How long are laptop backups kept?
expected: Thirty days of daily snapshots, then one monthly snapshot for a year.

input: Who approves a software licence renewal?
expected: The owning team's budget holder, in the procurement tool.
